newsitem.title: USA: Conrail says court date now set for Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: Conrail says court date now set for Nov 18.

text.p: Conrail Inc said its Nov. 12 court hearing with Norfolk Southern Corp has been postponed until Nov. 18.
Norfolk Southern, which has launched an unsolicited bid for Conrail, has filed suit to block a proposed acquisition of the railroad by CSX Corp.
Conrail said the hearing postponement was made at the request of Norfolk Southern.
Norfolk Southern had no immediate comment on the court date.
On Wednesday CSX raised its cash-and-stock bid for Conrail. The new offer values Conrail at about $93 a share, according to stock market sources.
Norfolk Southern, which has said it is reviewing its options, is widely expected to raise its $100-cash-per-share bid for Conrail.
